_source: questlog.gg Aion 2 database (https://questlog.gg/aion-2/en/db), Alchemy > Magic Stone recipes, extracted 2026-10-26
_notes: Superior manastones and soulstones, the ones worth selling. Each can be made two ways: (combo) the Intermediate recipe from Lesser stones has a 20% combo chance to give the Superior stone instead, so one costs the attempts it takes to hit the combo (about 5); (regular) only the plain Superior Manastone / Soulstone also have a recipe from 30 Intermediate stones. Abyssal stones only come from the combo. Recipe ids 31xxxxxxx are Elyos and 32xxxxxxx Asmodian; both factions use the same items, materials and levels. mastery_level is the recipe's Alchemy level on the game's 1-100 scale (questlog's 'Lv'). The inks are bound and sold by the Alchemy Merchant NPC (npc_prices). Spiritstone Powder can also be crafted from Spiritstone (10 Spiritstone -> 30 Powder, recipe 315016011). Lesser Abyssal Manastone / Soulstone and Lesser Soulstone come from drops and weekly supply requests and aren't tracked on aion2.exchange, so they have no market price; the dashboard asks the viewer for their value.
